description_en: Adds a zone to an endpoint
description_zh: 调用AddZoneToVpcEndpoint接口，为终端节点添加可用区
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink add-zone-to-vpc-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --vswitch-id vsw-hjkshjvdkdvd0000 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddZoneToVpcEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint to which you want to add a zone.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要添加可用区的终端节点所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone to add
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch in the zone to add. The system automatically creates an endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in this vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的可用区中的交换机，系统会自动在该交换机下创建一个终端节点网卡
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in the zone to add. You can specify an active IP address in the vSwitch of the zone. The system automatically assigns an IP address to the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) from the network interface controller (NIC) if you do not specify one
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的可用区中的终端节点网卡的IP
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint to which you want to add a zone
parameters.help_zh: 要添加可用区的终端节点的ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without adding the zone. The system checks required parameters, request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 address of the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in the zone to add. You can specify an active IPv6 address in the vSwitch of the zone. The system automatically assigns an IPv6 address to the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) from the network interface controller (NIC) if you do not specify one
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的可用区中的终端节点网卡的IPv6地址
parameters.name: ipv6_address
